usage.outputShape: body.product_title; body.history[] (timestamp, price, currency); body.statistics (mean, std_dev, min_price, max_price, current_price, current_status, currency)
quirks: Required query param canonical_product_id is an opaque Channel3 catalog id (e.g. 'VN9WKnq'), NOT a name or URL.
Obtain a valid canonical_product_id from the Channel3 image/product search endpoint (POST https://stableproduct.dev/api/channel3/image-search -> body.products[].id) before calling this.
The 402 payment gate fires BEFORE param validation: a call with a missing/invalid canonical_product_id still charges then fails, so always supply a real id.
Optional query params: days (integer 1-30) and include_raw (boolean).
usage.guide: Call GET https://stableproduct.dev/api/channel3/price-tracking/history with a required canonical_product_id query param set to a real Channel3 catalog product id (get one from POST .../channel3/image-search, field body.products[].id). Optionally add days=1..30 and include_raw=true. It is x402-paid ($0.01 USDC on Base) and returns plain sync JSON. Read the price series from body.history[] (each {timestamp, price, currency}) and the summary from body.statistics.
